version_history.changes: Initial C++ TextSplitterEngine stream splitter, 64KB buffer, UTF-8 codepoint protection, subfolder output generation.
version_history.build_notes: Compiled with MinGW g++ 13.2.0. Passed 12 internal C++ engine unit tests.

version_history.changes: Fixed line unit counting for non-trailing newlines, overwriteExisting=false flag enforcement, cancellation check order, and full file cleanup.
version_history.build_notes: Passed 12/12 C++ unit tests, 18/18 stress tests, and 6/6 Python E2E integration tests.

version_history.changes: Full Win32 GUI implementation: Title Banner, 3D Inset, Darker Chin, Segoe UI, multi-line tooltips, About dialog expander, Help/Settings dialogs, Statusbar, Toolbar, Drag & Drop, sideloaded dynamic icon, async std::thread, and %SystemDrive%\EliteSoftware\Logs\FileSplitter.log logger.
